sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Emerald Crystal Leaf Vine Necklace
sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a touch of enchantment to your style with this emerald crystal vine necklace. Featuring a vibrant green oval centerpiece flanked by shimmering crystal-encrusted leaves, this anti-tarnish gold chain is a perfect reminder that life is magical. A beautiful, nature-inspired accessory ideal for gifting or everyday elegance
